FAIL_TO_PASS: tdz-common: preserve common TDZ violations
if-statement-breaks: handles conditionally broken execution
preserve-for-of-iterable: preserves for...of loops
supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
supports-core-js: supports core-js
loop-errors: does not break flow from inside loops that may not have executed
side-effect-e: accounts for local scopes when tested function purity
invalid-property-calls: includes invalid property calls
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
self-deoptimization: handles situations where a member expression is deoptimized while being deoptimized
nested-inlined-dynamic-import-1: deconflicts variables when nested dynamic imports are inlined via inlineDynamicImports
returned-array-mutation: tracks array mutations
already-deshadowed-import: handle already module import names correctly if they are have already been deshadowed
redeclare-var-function: allows to redeclare vars and functions as vars and functions in function scopes
handles-async-await: properly handles exporting async functions
deconflict-parameter-defaults: consistently deconflict variable names for parameter defaults
track-awaited-object: tracks object mutations through await
track-async-function-return-value: tracks object mutations of async function return values
caught-errors: breaks control flow when an error is thrown inside a catch block
removes-unused-babel-helpers: Removes unused babel helpers from the build (#1595)
